summary: Notes and Capsules take an initialItem prop. App passes loc.params.item, so #/notes?item=n_2 and #/capsules?item=c_2 select that record on first render, and a later hash change to another item opens it (through the existing unsaved-changes dialog). An unknown id keeps the default first record.
Seven new routes, appended to VIEWS so existing Alt+1..0 shortcuts do not move: Avatar (Cockpit), Routines, Clipboard history, Calendar (Work), Models, Integrations, Usage (System).

Routines, Integrations, Models, Usage and Clipboard build their clients with routinesBridge, integrationsBridge, modelsBridge, usageBridge and clipboardBridge from src/ui/bridges.ts, memoised on the api. Each adapter returns null unless every method of its list exists; the page then shows a 'not connected' notice and disabled controls rather than a fake state.

Models passes currentModel from settings and saves the localModel patch through api.saveSettings (the main process owns the AI-connection confirmation). Usage uses the real UsagePanel with report, performance and CSV/JSON export through the bridge. Clipboard is a small inline view: opt-in switch (native confirmation happens in main), list, copy back, remove, delete all.

Calendar and Avatar have no connected backend or editor component in this tree, so they are honest 'not connected' pages with a disabled Import .ics file and Edit avatar button. Avatar also shows the live avatar and links to Companion.

Tests: heading table covers all 20 views; a connected-api fixture built from the real method lists feeds the accessible-name audits; new tests cover reachability, not-connected states, connected states, and one missing method disconnecting only its own page.
interfaces_requested_from_captain: Calendar: an IPC bridge and a view component. Needed: bridge methods to import an .ics file (main-process open dialog, text bounded by MAX_ICS_BYTES), list events in a range, and clear events, plus calendarBridge(api) in src/ui/bridges.ts and a component taking the client. CalendarEvent is not in src/shared/contracts.ts. Until then CalendarView in App.tsx stays a disabled stub.

Avatar: src/components/AvatarStudio.tsx does not exist in the original repository or the visual worker's tree yet (only src/ui/avatar-editor.ts). Needed: its exported component and props, then replace AvatarView's notice with it.

Clipboard: no component exists, so ClipboardView lives inside App.tsx. The captain may move it to its own file. The native main must call capture() on a timer while history is on; the renderer cannot.
Usage: UsageClient.setPrices and setBudget are bridged but UsagePanel has no inputs for them, so prices and the budget cannot be edited from this page.
docs/autopilot-shell-runtime.md still describes five todo tests and the 13-view table; it is not in this task's paths.
limitations: Server rendering only: effects do not run, so the loaded states of Usage, Clipboard, Models and Routines (data returned by the bridge) and every click are not exercised; only the connected/not-connected initial render is.
Static imports, not lazy: server rendering and the test bundle need the content in the first render, and the renderer chunk-size warning predates this change.
Nothing here changes backend, shared contracts or package.json. Nothing was committed or pushed.
